quarters.label: Q4 FY26

promises.speaker: Amrit Manwani, Chairman & MD
promises.quote: With that, I would say that it appears that, and after the merger, we plan for a merger together with our nonlisted Company, which, so together with that, we seem set for our goal to achieve a revenue of about Rs.275 Crores to Rs.300 Crores for the merged entity and with a reasonably strong profit margin of about 15%.
promises.basis: Consolidated revenue, merged entity (SESL+SSPL+SEPL+ITPL+SSSDPL), appointed date 1-Apr-2026
promises.source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.6
promises.note: Open. Merger needs NSE/SEBI/NCLT approval; if not effective in FY27, test against ex-merger guidance (210-220). Q1 FY27 business update (NSE 2026-07-18): consolidated revenue Rs48.0 Cr provisional; company says 'on track'.

promises.speaker: Amrit Manwani, Chairman & MD
promises.quote: No, we are talking about PBT margins of 15%.
promises.basis: PBT margin, merged entity, consolidated
promises.source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.7
promises.note: Open. Clarifies the '15% profit margin' in the preceding statement as PBT.

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: So, if we look at the listed entity, your Company, the entire listed entity, so we will be looking to target around about Rs.160 Crores from SESL, which is the listed entity. We are targeting approximately Rs.50 Crores from the semiconductor entity.
promises.basis: SESL standalone revenue Rs160 Cr; SSPL (semiconductor subsidiary) revenue Rs50 Cr
promises.source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.7
promises.note: Open. Q1 FY27 standalone Rs33.0 Cr provisional (NSE 2026-07-18). SSPL Rs50 Cr is the same figure guided for FY26 (delivered Rs15.7 Cr).

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: If you keep out the entities that are going to merge, of we keep them out, by FY2027, our guidance is anywhere between let us say Rs.210 Crores to 220 Crores
promises.basis: Consolidated revenue ex-merger (SESL + SSPL)
promises.source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.17
promises.note: Open.

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: So, based on the current visibility and operating trajectory, we continue to target EBITDA breakeven in the semiconductor business by FY2027 end.
promises.basis: SSPL segment EBITDA >= 0
promises.source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.4
promises.note: Open. Second deferral: breakeven was promised for FY26 in the 30-May-2025 call. Chairman (p.8) frames it as cash breakeven at Rs50 Cr revenue, depreciation possibly uncovered.

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: As far as utilization goes, we are targeting that from 22% so that we can at least go upwards of 40% utilization.
promises.basis: Bhiwadi EMS unit capacity utilisation (FY26: 22.5%)
promises.source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.15
promises.note: Open. Period inferred from analyst's FY2027 framing of the question.

promises.speaker: Amrit Manwani, Chairman & MD
promises.quote: However, we are hoping that the merger would be in place by the end of the financial year or earlier.
promises.basis: Amalgamation of SEPL, ITPL, SSSDPL into SESL effective
promises.source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.7
promises.note: Open. Scheme approved by board 13-Mar-2026; filed with NSE; SEBI and NCLT pending.

promises.speaker: Maneesh Tiwari, CFO
promises.quote: So we are considering and calculating on the basis of useful life of the machine which is now basically for 15 years so over the next 15 years we will show that in the part as other income for the subsidiary company
promises.basis: SPECS capital subsidy (Rs21.9 Cr) recognised as deferred income in other income over 15 years (~Rs1.6 Cr/yr per CFO)
promises.source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.13-14
promises.note: Open. Normalisation item: subsidy amortisation inflates other income; FY26 included catch-up portion.

promises.speaker: Maneesh Tiwari, CFO
promises.quote: So, that is why, considering all the factors, we believe that we will be positive by the end of FY2028.
promises.basis: Consolidated cash flow from operations > 0 (FY25 -5.9 Cr; FY26 -10.1 Cr)
promises.source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.20
promises.note: Open. Earlier in the same call CFO said 'by the end of next year' (p.19) before settling on FY28.

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: so by FY2028, we will definitely be looking at the range of Rs.300 Crores.
promises.basis: Consolidated revenue ex-merger (SESL + SSPL)
promises.source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.17
promises.note: Open.

promises.speaker: Amrit Manwani, Chairman & MD
promises.quote: The semiconductor business would, as I said, at Rs.50 Crores, it will kind of have break even in the future year that is 2027-2028, we are looking at a revenue only for semiconductors at about Rs.150 Crores and if that happens, then we will have a 10% PAT on semiconductors, but overall we will have a 16% to 17% PAT for the group.
promises.basis: SSPL revenue Rs150 Cr, SSPL PAT margin 10%; group PAT margin 16-17%
promises.source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.9
promises.note: Open. Cuts the FY28 SSPL Rs250 Cr target from the 30-May-2025 call (graded there).

promises.speaker: Amrit Manwani, Chairman & MD
promises.quote: Well, definitely we are looking at FY2029, we would have reached that figure.
promises.basis: Consolidated revenue Rs600-650 Cr (EMS + semiconductor + merged entities)
promises.source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.21
promises.note: Open. 'That figure' = Rs600-700 Cr peak referenced by the analyst (p.9-10, p.20).

quarters.note: H2 FY26 call 2026-05-29. All promises relate to FY27 or later.

promises.speaker: Maneesh Tiwari, CFO
promises.quote: And if you see our last guidance, we have given the projected revenue of INR130 crores. So, in a way, we are on the halfway and we are expecting that the second half would be better than the first one.
promises.basis: SESL standalone revenue from operations
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.4
promises.outcome: Rs123.6 Cr (shortfall 4.9%)
promises.outcome_source: FY26 investor presentation, NSE filing 2026-05-28, p.32 (standalone income statement)

promises.speaker: Maneesh Tiwari, CFO
promises.quote: Now, since the turnover has been increased, still we are maintaining the EBITDA of 12.63%, which is quite healthy. And management is trusting and they are hoping that we would be able to sustain this EBITDA in the coming quarters also.
promises.basis: Standalone EBITDA margin excl. other income
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.5
promises.outcome: 15.2% (EBITDA Rs18.8 Cr on Rs123.6 Cr)
promises.outcome_source: FY26 investor presentation, NSE filing 2026-05-28, p.32
promises.note: H1 EBITDA margin derived from filed FY26 numbers is ~10.1% (18.8-13.3 on 54.2), not 12.63% as stated; FY target still met on the full-year figure.

promises.speaker: Maneesh Tiwari, CFO
promises.quote: And PAT we are also maintaining the PAT of 15.49%, which is quite good compared to last full year of 9.13%.
promises.basis: Standalone PAT margin incl. other income
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.5
promises.outcome_source: FY26 investor presentation, NSE filing 2026-05-28, p.32
promises.note: Derived H1 PAT margin from filed numbers ~9.4% (5.1/54.2) vs 15.49% stated. FY26 PAT includes other income Rs7.7 Cr (incl. interest on loans to SSPL).

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: With this recovery, while we may not be able to achieve the initial numbers that we had suggested, but we will at least be able to recover to the extent that we can at least reach similar to the last year's revenue.
promises.basis: Semiconductor segment revenue >= FY25 (Rs10.31 Cr)
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.6
promises.outcome: Rs15.7 Cr
promises.outcome_source: FY26 investor presentation, NSE filing 2026-05-28, p.6 (segment split, consolidated)
promises.note: This statement is the in-period cut of the Rs50 Cr FY26 semiconductor target (graded against original in Q4 FY25 call).

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: So now depending upon the time that would be taken, we hope to get the first tranche of our grant back from the government. And hopefully we can have that to be completed before the end of the financial year.
promises.basis: SPECS capital subsidy disbursement to SSPL (Rs20-22 Cr per Chairman, p.10)
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.6
promises.outcome: Final disbursement Rs18.60 Cr received; total approved Rs21.89 Cr (sanction 31-Dec-2025); Rs3.28 Cr earlier tranche
promises.outcome_source: Intimation of final disbursement of SPECS incentive, letter to NSE dated 2026-03-31
promises.note: Amount Rs21.89 Cr is within the Rs20-22 Cr stated.

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: So in the next few weeks, we hope to have a final merger scheme available based on which we will seek further approval from the board for the merger scheme.
promises.period: Q3 FY26 (by 31-Dec-2025, generous reading of 'next few weeks')
promises.basis: Board approval of final scheme of amalgamation
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.6
promises.outcome: Board approved scheme on 13-Mar-2026 (<= 1 quarter late)
promises.outcome_source: Outcome of board meeting 13-Mar-2026, NSE filing 2026-03-13

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: So, this will be to the tune of INR15 crores, whereby we will be bringing in two other SMT lines, along with other peripheral equipment, so that the diversification that we are looking at, we are able to fulfill all those product requirements.
promises.basis: Two new SMT lines at Bhiwadi (capex ~Rs15 Cr)
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.4
promises.outcome: Lines arrived late Apr-2026, installed and operational May-2026 (<= 1 quarter late)
promises.outcome_source: H2 FY26 transcript (29-May-2026), NSE filing 2026-06-02, p.4-5 (management: 'supposed to come in by March 2026')
promises.note: No date was given in the Nov-2025 call; the March-2026 target is management's own statement in the 29-May-2026 call. Capex amount not verified.

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: However, we will be getting into mass production, as I said, in March, April timeframe and so, that will definitely contribute to the revenue in the next fiscal year.
promises.basis: eSIM mass production at SSPL for European customer
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.5
promises.note: [not retrieved] Period closed; neither the FY26 investor presentation, the 29-May-2026 call nor the Q1 FY27 business update mentions eSIM production status. Not graded.

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: The very first production shipment should be leaving our facility sometime in December.
promises.basis: First production shipment of export metering product (Dutch client)
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.3
promises.note: [not retrieved] No filing found confirming the shipment date. Not graded.

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: however, we plan that before the end of the financial year, we are also able to get further certification of ISO45001 and ISO14001
promises.basis: ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certification, Bhiwadi unit
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.3
promises.note: [not retrieved] FY26 presentation p.11 says 'aligned with' ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 - not evidence of unit certification. Not graded.

promises.speaker: Varun Manwani, Non-Executive Director
promises.quote: We'll always be targeting 50% and above.
promises.basis: Export share of revenue, consolidated
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.13
promises.outcome_source: FY26 investor presentation, NSE filing 2026-05-28, p.19
promises.note: Graded at the FY26 checkpoint; standing target.

promises.speaker: Amrit Manwani, Chairman & MD
promises.quote: So, we are not looking at any further dilution. We are, as you rightly understood INR50 crores from internal generation and INR50 crores from debt.
promises.basis: Rs200 Cr ISM 2.0 semiconductor capex funded 50% grant, Rs50 Cr internal, Rs50 Cr debt; no equity dilution
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.11
promises.note: Open. In the 29-May-2026 call (p.19) Chairman said the company would 'remain open to all the various options... whether it is from debt or whether it is from any other source'. Merger share issuance (promoter 69.9% -> 74.1%) is separate from this capex assurance.

promises.speaker: Amrit Manwani, Chairman & MD
promises.quote: we are expecting that in this year, they would also achieve a turnover of about INR90 to INR100 crores with a PAT of about INR8 to INR10 crores.
promises.basis: Unlisted Sahasra Electronics Pvt Ltd (merger target) revenue Rs90-100 Cr, PAT Rs8-10 Cr; ITPL revenue Rs18-20 Cr (p.14)
promises.source: H1 FY26 transcript (18-Nov-2025), company IR page seslimited.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SahasraElectronic-Earnings-Nov18-2025.pdf, p.14
promises.note: Not graded: no filed FY26 accounts for the unlisted entities retrieved. 9M FY26 turnover per scheme disclosure: SEPL Rs69.72 Cr, ITPL Rs12.76 Cr (board outcome 13-Mar-2026). Chairman (29-May-2026, p.24) said ITPL did ~Rs16 Cr in FY26.

promises.outcome_source: FY26 investor presentation, NSE filing 2026-05-28, p.35

promises.speaker: Amrit Manwani, Chairman & MD

promises.outcome_source: Outcome of board meeting 13-Mar-2026, NSE filing 2026-03-13
